_comment: What the patch restores. Shared by all target languages; see TECHNICAL_NOTES.md (What Steam Censored, Censored Images).

censored_scenes._comment: Scenes the Steam release censored by rewriting them: the JP scene is ported over the target's version.

removed_scenes._comment: Scenes the Steam release removed: scene -> target script whose JUMP must lead into it (aligned with the JP version of that script).

censored_images._comment: Pictures the Steam release edited; the target scripts show them at the same points as the JP scripts, so the JP data replaces them in place (same resource ID).

split_images._comment: Target slots holding a different (substitute) picture still shown by unported target scripts: the JP picture is appended under a new name and only ported scenes use it.

script_fixes._comment: In-place fixes in unported target scripts where Steam changed how a censored picture is shown.

fixes.why: Steam inserted its own frame e007k0; JP shows e007k1 at that point
JP e045 is 2160 px tall (Steam 1934): scroll to its bottom like the JP script

start_sequence._comment: JP: New Game -> prologue (0000-op0_HD, ends with the opening movie) -> new_game_script; the Rengoku movie plays in 0308-02-00 before part 2. Steam moved the prologue to 0308-02-00 (which calls it) and the Rengoku movie to the end of 0209-08-00, and swapped the two movie files' names (Steam cartagra_movie_01 = JP cartagra_movie_02 and vice versa). The executable starts New Game at new_game_script, which now calls the prologue first.

exe_fixes._comment: Byte patches of the target executable (RVA, original bytes, new bytes); the build stops if the original bytes differ. See TECHNICAL_NOTES.md, Sound Crash.

fixes.name: sound length uses 48000 Hz instead of a stale vorbis_info (division by zero)
fixes.why: cSoundCodec_Ogg length-in-ms (0x2f4220) reads the rate from the channel's vorbis_info pointer, which the decoder thread replaces only after ov_open and never clears; the main thread asks right after starting a sound, so it can read the previous, freed one and divide by rate/1000 = 0. All game audio is 48000 Hz; the jump takes the function's own 48000 default

exe_original_text._comment: The Russian release's translators put the Russian prologue text into an added section .rtransl and pointed 58 lea instructions at it; the rest of its CARTAGRA.exe is the Steam original (compared with the Steam executable). Languages with exe_original_text (en) point each lea back to its original English string and remove the section; an executable without the section is left as it is. Pairs: [lea instruction RVA, original string RVA]. See TECHNICAL_NOTES.md, Strings in CARTAGRA.exe.
